topics.title: Tut's story and the night he left his tomb

concepts.learning_objective: Recall the key facts of Tut's life, death and the 1922 discovery of his tomb.
Interpret the imagery and beliefs (such as the pharaoh's curse) in the opening scene of the account.

topics.title: Howard Carter's investigation of the mummy

concepts.learning_objective: Explain why and how Carter freed the mummy from its coffin and adornments.
Describe the treasures and everyday objects buried with Tut and what they reveal about Egyptian beliefs.

topics.title: Changing archaeology: from X-ray to CT scan

concepts.learning_objective: Explain how the aims and tools of archaeology have changed since Carter's time.
Explain how computed tomography works and why it was used on Tut.

topics.title: Tut's dynasty and the Amarna period

concepts.learning_objective: Identify Akhenaten's religious changes and why they were seen as strange.
Explain Tut's change of name, his restoration of the old ways and his place among Egypt's mummies.

topics.title: The night of the CT scan

concepts.learning_objective: Recall the events of the scan night and what they reveal about the people involved.
Analyse the mood and figures of speech in the closing description of the account.
Identify the images, colours and comparisons used to describe the tree and the goldfinch.
Explain the engine metaphor for the goldfinch and her family.
Analyse how the stillness at the beginning and end frames the poem.

topics.title: The Voice of the Rain (Walt Whitman)

concepts.learning_objective: Identify the speakers and the meaning of key words in the poem.
Relate the poem's description of the rain to the water cycle.
Explain the parallel drawn between the rain and a song or poem.
